name: Whoogle
description: Whoogle is a self-hosted, privacy-focused search engine front-end for accessing Google search results without tracking and data collection.
composeYaml:
services:
  whoogle:
    image: 'benbusby/whoogle-search:latest'
    environment:
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:5000'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
